Coordinate.description: A value the solver works out, in millimetres: a number, read correctly rounded to the nearest 64-bit float, and written in full as the shortest decimal that reads back as it. Within a kilometre of the origin.

ElementId.description: A sketch element's ID: 8 characters of Crockford's base32 in lower case (digits and letters but i, l, o, and u), unique within its sketch.

FeatureId.description: A feature's ID: 8 characters of Crockford's base32 in lower case (digits and letters but i, l, o, and u).

request.description:
`drag_begin`'s request: begin a drag of a sketch's point, or of a curve's edge, on a
sketch worker of its own. It queues behind the session's commands before it, and drags
the sketch as the session holds it when it runs. One drag is open in a session at once.

curve.description:
The curve whose edge to drag, by its ID: a line moves whole, a circle or an arc is
sized through the cursor. Null to drag a point.

point.description:
The point to drag, by its ID (a line's end, an arc's start, end, or centre, a
circle's centre, a lone point); null to drag a curve's edge.

press.description:
Where the press on the curve's edge landed, `[x, y]` in the sketch's coordinates:
each move's offset is from it, and a release there is a click, which changes
nothing. Null to drag a point.

session.description: The session's ID, as `open` gave it.

sketch.description: The sketch, by its feature's ID.

request.title: DragBeginRequest

curve.description: The curve whose edge is dragged, as the request named it; null for a point.

dofs.description:
The sketch's degrees of freedom left as it began. A point no constraint leaves free
still begins a drag, and its frames don't move it.

moves.description:
The points of the part of the sketch the drag moves, by ID: every other point stays
where it began. A diagnostic.

point.description: The point dragged, as the request named it; null for a curve's edge.

press.description: The press, as the request gave it; null for a point.

sketch.description: The sketch, as the request named it.
